title: Best Gyms in Auckland 2026 — City-by-City Guide with Prices
meta_desc: Find the best gyms in Auckland with our city-by-city guide, featuring prices and commuter options
intro: With over 100 gyms across Auckland, choosing the right one can be overwhelming. The average Auckland gym membership costs around $30-50 per week. In this guide, we'll explore the best gyms in each suburb, including their prices and contract terms.

sections.heading: Auckland CBD Gyms
sections.body: The Auckland CBD has a high concentration of gyms, with popular options including Les Mills, City Fitness, and Jetts. These gyms offer a range of membership options, from casual visits to long-term contracts.

sections.heading: Gyms by Suburb
list: North Shore: Les Mills (Takapuna), City Fitness (Albany)
South Auckland: Snap Fitness (Papakura), City Fitness (Manurewa)

sections.heading: Parking and Accessibility
sections.body: Many gyms in Auckland offer on-site parking, while others are located near public transport hubs. It's essential to consider parking and accessibility when choosing a gym, especially if you plan to commute to the city center.
